owner_creation.invariant: The wrapper owns no retained application data.

aliases_escapes.analysis: In src/bin/rless.rs, no parameters or local references are lent across either call; pager::main owns any later argument storage itself.

callback_targets.analysis: In src/bin/rless.rs, both call targets are statically named Rust functions, not callbacks chosen from a pointer table.

invalidation.analysis: In src/bin/rless.rs, the wrapper has no local storage that can be invalidated while pager::main runs or exits.

mutation_commit.analysis: In src/bin/rless.rs, process::init runs before pager::main, restoring inherited SIGPIPE before translated application processing.

release_pair.analysis: In src/bin/rless.rs, no resource is acquired here and no manual release is required by a return or pager process exit.

error_cleanup.analysis: In src/bin/rless.rs, this wrapper has no local fallible commit or cleanup block; failure/exit behavior belongs to the named callees reviewed separately.
